fullDescription: A luxe dark, gold-on-black editorial SaaS pricing page with a high-contrast serif, an elevated glowing featured tier, monthly/annual toggle, and a refined FAQ accordion.

structured.summary: A luxe, editorial three-tier SaaS pricing page rendered in a near-black 'atelier' palette with warm gold/champagne accents and a high-contrast Fraunces serif. A centered hero with a monthly/annual toggle sits above a 3-column tier grid where the middle plan is elevated, glowing, and badged 'Most chosen'; below it an enterprise contact bar, a serif trust strip, and a quietly elegant FAQ accordion. The whole thing reads like a boutique studio brochure, not a generic SaaS table.

style.description: Dark, gilded, editorial luxury. Deep matte-black canvas layered with slightly lighter charcoal panels, hairline borders, and a single warm metallic accent family (gold to champagne) used sparingly for emphasis, gradients, and the gold text-clip on the hero word and featured price. Typography pairs a high-contrast display serif (Fraunces) for headlines/prices/plan names with a clean grotesque sans (Inter) for body and UI. Generous whitespace, soft gold radial glow at the top, faint panel shadows, all-caps wide-tracked micro-labels, and a refined, expensive restraint.
style.prompt: Design a dark luxury 'atelier' aesthetic. Palette: ink/near-black background #0a0a0c, slightly lighter section coal #111114, raised card panel #16161a, hairline borders #26262c. Accents from a warm metallic family: gold #d4af72, champagne #e8d3a8, soft gold #b89b6a; muted text fog #9a9aa2 and mist #c8c8d0, pure white #ffffff for headlines. Signature treatment: a vertical gold gradient (#f3e3bf -> #d4af72 -> #b89b6a) clipped to text for the emphasized hero word and the featured tier's price, plus a champagne->soft-gold button/badge gradient. Fonts: 'Fraunces' (a high-contrast optical serif, weights 300-700, used italic for accents) for headlines, plan names, prices and FAQ questions; 'Inter' (300-600) for body and UI. Use all-caps micro-labels with wide letter-spacing (~0.18-0.24em) in soft gold, hairline 1px dividers, large rounded-2xl cards, pill-shaped buttons, a faint gold radial glow behind the hero, and a soft gold panel glow + 1px gold ring on the featured card. Keep accents restrained and expensive; everything else quiet and dark.

layout_and_structure.description: A frameless, responsive single-column web page on a max-w-7xl container: sticky blurred nav, a narrow centered hero with billing toggle, a 3-column tier grid (the middle tier visually lifted and highlighted) that reflows 3 -> 2 -> 1 column, an enterprise contact bar, a serif trust/logos strip, a centered FAQ accordion, and a multi-column footer. Sections are separated by whitespace and hairline rules rather than boxes.

prompts.prompt: A sticky, full-width top header with a translucent dark blur background (rgba(10,10,12,0.72) + backdrop-blur) and a bottom hairline border. Left: a small rounded gold-gradient logo tile holding a 'diamonds-four' diamond glyph next to a serif wordmark 'Atelier' in champagne with a lighter ' Prompts' in fog. Center (md+): text nav links (Library, Showcase, Pricing active in champagne, FAQ) in small fog text that brighten to champagne on hover. Right: a 'Sign in' text link and a pill 'Start free' CTA with a faint gold border and gold/10 fill. Collapses the center nav on mobile.

A narrow centered hero (max-w-3xl). Start with an uppercase wide-tracked pill eyebrow 'THE PROMPT ATELIER' (with a sparkle icon) in soft gold on a coal pill with hairline border. Then a large high-contrast serif headline up to ~4.4rem: 'Pricing, composed with intention.' where the word 'composed' is italic and filled with the gold text-clip gradient. Below, a fog subhead one to two lines wide about turning a single line of language into shippable interface. Then a centered billing switch: 'Monthly' label, a small pill toggle with a gold-gradient knob that slides, and an 'Annual' label carrying a 'save 20%' gold mini-badge. Toggling swaps every price and period note (monthly <-> discounted annual).

prompts.partPt: Three-tier Planos e Preços grid (the core layout)
prompts.prompt: A responsive pricing grid: grid-cols-1 on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop (cards reflow 3 -> 2 -> 1). Three rounded-2xl tier cards. Tier 1 'Muse' (free): plan name in serif, fog description, a serif '$0 / forever' price, an all-caps 'NO CARD REQUIRED' note, an outlined gold-border pill CTA 'Begin for free' with arrow, and a check-list of features (soft-gold check icons). Tier 2 'Studio' (featured, center): on the panel background #16161a, lifted slightly upward on desktop (negative top margin), wrapped in a 1px gold ring + soft gold panel glow, with a champagne->soft-gold 'Most chosen' badge pinned to its top edge. Its price uses the gold text-clip gradient ($29 / month, $23 annual), CTA is a solid champagne->gold gradient pill 'Choose Studio', and the feature list is prefaced 'Everything in Muse, plus' with brighter gold check-bold icons and white text. Tier 3 'Atelier' (team, $79/seat): same quiet card style as Muse with an outlined CTA 'Choose Atelier' and an 'Everything in Studio, plus' team feature list; on tablet it spans both columns and lays itself out in two internal columns, then returns to a single normal card on desktop. Each card is flex-column so CTAs and lists align across the row.

Below the grid, a full-width rounded-2xl bar with a subtle coal->panel horizontal gradient and hairline border. Left: a circular gold-bordered icon tile (buildings glyph) beside a serif heading 'Need an enterprise commission?' and a fog line about dedicated infrastructure, custom SLAs, security review, white-glove onboarding. Right: an outlined gold-border pill CTA 'Talk to our team' with an up-right arrow. Stacks centered on mobile, splits left/right on md+.

A centered trust strip: an uppercase wide-tracked fog micro-label 'CRAFTED BY MAKERS AT', then a row of five faux studio wordmarks set in the serif at ~xl size, some italic, in dimmed fog (fog/70), wrapping and spacing generously. No real logos, just elegant serif names (Lumiere, Forge&Co, Northwind, Vera Labs, Atlas Studio).

A centered FAQ section (max-w-3xl) titled 'Questions, answered' in a large serif. A vertical list of native <details> accordion rows separated by hairline dividers; each summary is a serif question in white with a soft-gold plus icon on the right that rotates 45deg into an x when open. The first item is open by default. Answers are small relaxed fog paragraphs. Keep the support voice warm and human (e.g. 'Ping us and we'll sort it together').

A coal-background footer with a top hairline border. Top row: left, the gold-tile logo + serif 'Atelier Prompts' wordmark and a short fog tagline ('Language into interface. An AI product-design agent on an infinite canvas.'); right, a wrapped row of fog nav links (Library, Showcase, Pricing, FAQ, Privacy) that brighten to champagne on hover. Bottom row above another hairline: a small copyright line and a set of social icon links (X, GitHub, Discord). Stacks centered on mobile, spreads horizontally on sm+/md+.

special_ui_components.description: The signature 'gilded' typographic effect used on the emphasized hero word and the featured tier's price.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply a vertical linear-gradient (180deg, #f3e3bf 0%, #d4af72 55%, #b89b6a 100%) clipped to the text via background-clip: text with transparent fill, so the serif glyphs read as polished gold. Use it sparingly: only the accent hero word ('composed', italic) and the featured price.

special_ui_components.description: Makes the middle 'Studio' card feel premium and selected without changing its size much.
special_ui_components.prompt: On the center card, add a 1px gold ring (box-shadow inset-like ring at rgba(212,175,114,0.35)) plus a layered soft glow: a long downward gold drop shadow and a wide diffuse gold halo (e.g. 0 40px 80px -40px rgba(212,175,114,0.25), 0 0 120px -60px rgba(212,175,114,0.4)). Lift it slightly with a negative top margin on desktop and pin a champagne->soft-gold 'Most chosen' badge to its top edge.

special_ui_components.description: A small pill switch that live-swaps every price, period label, and billing note across all tiers.
special_ui_components.prompt: A ~58px pill toggle on a coal background with hairline border and a gold-gradient knob (champagne->soft-gold) that slides ~31px on click. 'Monthly' and 'Annual' labels flank it; the active label is champagne, inactive is fog, and 'Annual' carries a 'save 20%' gold mini-badge. On toggle, update each price from its monthly value to a ~20%-lower annual value, switch period text ('/ month' <-> '/ mo, billed yearly') and the small notes ('Billed monthly, cancel anytime' / 'Per seat...' <-> yearly variants).

special_ui_components.description: Lightweight, dependency-free accordion using native details/summary.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use native <details>/<summary> with the default marker hidden. Each summary shows a serif question and a soft-gold 'plus' icon; when the details is open, rotate that icon 45deg (becoming an x) with a 0.25s transition. First row open by default; rows divided by hairline rules only.

special_ui_components.description: A consistent rounded-full button system with a primary gold-gradient variant and a quieter outlined variant.
special_ui_components.prompt: Primary CTA: rounded-full pill with a champagne->soft-gold gradient fill, dark ink text, slight brightness-up on hover, with a trailing arrow that nudges right on hover. Secondary CTA: same pill shape but transparent with a gold/35-40 border and champagne text, filling to a faint gold/10 on hover. Use primary only on the featured tier; outlined elsewhere.

structured.special_notes: This is a frameless, fully responsive web page (not a fixed frame): a max-w-7xl centered container, sticky blurred nav, and a tier grid that reflows 3 -> 2 -> 1 column across desktop/tablet/mobile (the team tier even spans 2 columns and re-lays-out at the tablet breakpoint). Built with Tailwind (CDN config defining the ink/coal/panel/gold/champagne palette), Fraunces + Inter from Google Fonts, and Iconify Phosphor icons. The only JS is the billing toggle that rewrites prices/labels; the FAQ uses native details. Keep accents restrained: gold is for emphasis (hero word, featured price/card, checks, badges, CTAs) against a mostly dark, quiet, editorial layout. Support/FAQ copy follows a warm, human voice (no em-dashes).
